_doc: Maps a TCGplayer card to a pull-rate tier. Rules are tested in order; the first match wins. Match fields (all optional, all must hold): era (list), groupIds (list), subset (subset role of the card's source group, or 'none'), rarity (exact TCGplayer Rarity string), name (regex on product name, case-insensitive), notName (regex that must NOT match), cardKind ('pokemon' | 'trainer' | 'energy', derived from extendedData 'Card Type'), cardType (regex on the raw 'Card Type'). A card no rule matches is written to build-report.unmappedRarities and left out of the EV. Tiers listed in `excludedTiers` are known non-pack cards and are dropped silently.
